_help: One character per team member plus a guide. This file is the one authoritative crew-to-colour table: 'suit' (suit colour), 'accent' (trim), 'suit_name' (the same in words), 'visor' (the dark reflective visor, the same for everyone). Faces are never shown: every astronaut wears a closed helmet. Crew members use sprite sheets made by tools/crew_astronauts.py (it measures proportions from each member's illustration in ../crew-illustrations and draws the suit in these colours; 'sheet': frame size, 'bust' crop for small portraits, frames idle/breath/talk/point). Re-run that tool after changing a colour; it updates 'sprite' and 'sheet' here. Ids stay stable: routes and data use them.

characters.name: Guide
characters.greeting: Welcome aboard! I can tell you what this site is, what microgravity means and which crew member to ask about each experiment.

characters.name: Amr Morgan
characters.greeting: I study how solid materials burn in microgravity: the BASS and BASS-II runs on the space station. Ask me about the runs, the oxygen readings or what the data cannot tell us.

characters.name: Mohamed Shreif
characters.greeting: I cover the large fire tests flown in empty cargo ships (SAFFIRE). My findings are in: ask me about the temperatures.

characters.name: Mahmoud Nadeem
characters.role: Smoke and aerosol detection (SAME, SAME-R, DAFT)
characters.greeting: I study the smoke that overheated spacecraft materials give off, and the instruments that measure it. Ask me anything about it!

characters.name: Mohammed Tamer
characters.greeting: I cover burning fuel droplets and cool flames (FLEX, FLEX-2, CFI). My FLEX findings are in: ask me about extinction.

characters.name: Khaled Adawi
characters.greeting: I study gas flames in the ACME experiments on the space station: BRE, E-FIELD Flames, s-Flame and Flame Design. Ask me about the BRE flight data and what it can and cannot show.

characters.name: Mohamed Gamal
characters.role: Soot and smoke points (SPICE, SLICE, CLD)
characters.greeting: I cover soot and smoke points of flames (SPICE, SLICE, CLD). My findings are in: ask me about the airflow and the flames.
